text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Before I knew it, my skin's broken 
out...

text_block_list.name: Buena's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's bad! Here, I'll lend you some 
of my cream!

text_block_list.name: Buena's Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I'll send you a skincare video later! 
Let's get our smooth skin back together!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone... That's so 
reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I really need to take this chance 
to rethink my skincare. Everyone went out 
of their way to help me, after all...
